description.narrative: Lesotho - Private Sector Development Project - Civil Legal Reform Activity: This Project activity is an element of a broader Government program of legal reform and will provide faster, fairer and less expensive resolution of commercial disputes, whether large or small. MCC funding will support the following: (i) the development of the Commercial Court; (ii) the creation of modern case management procedures; (iii) promotion of alternative dispute resolution ('ADR'); and (iv) the development of a simplified and expedited small claims process.
Capital of Lesotho, Maseru

condition.narrative: (1) Successful implementation of reforms in case management in High Court and Commercial Court. (2) Successful operation of Commercial Court - with appropriate jurisdiction, new procedural rules including mediation procedures, and sufficient dedicated staffing.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
Promulgation and presenting to parliament legislation and regulations (including data privacy) required to harmonize Lesotho's laws with the laws of other countries in the region.
